question: What provider-native evidence is required before landing this combined recorder and five-provider fidelity series?
rationale: Repository policy explicitly requires authoritative provider verification and, when practical, an actual compatible client, while the PR currently supplies only lint and unit-test evidence for broad compatibility- and delivery-sensitive changes.

options.title: Require focused native proof
options.body: Keep the series combined, but require authoritative references plus representative real-client or diagnostic output for the changed Matrix, Mattermost, Signal, Telegram, and Zalo contracts before merge.

options.title: Split the risk domains
options.body: Land recorder durability separately and review each provider-fidelity group in smaller PRs with provider-specific proof.

options.title: Accept unit-only evidence
options.body: Merge after ordinary code and CI review while explicitly accepting the remaining provider-fidelity uncertainty.

recommendation.title: Require focused native proof
recommendation.body: Keep the series combined, but require authoritative references plus representative real-client or diagnostic output for the changed Matrix, Mattermost, Signal, Telegram, and Zalo contracts before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa introduced the merged local Telegram driver foundation and is the strongest available feature-history owner for the provider-server architecture.
